How To Play Texas Hold 'Em

The Goal

Win chips from the other players. Make the best five-card poker hand, or get everyone else to fold. You win the game when you hold every chip on the riverboat.

How a Hand Goes

  1. Blinds: The two players to the left of the Dealer button put in the small blind and big blind to start the pot.
  2. Your two cards: Everyone gets two private cards, face down. Yours show at the bottom of the table.
  3. First betting round: Each player can Fold, Call (match the bet) or Raise.
  4. The Flop: Three shared cards go face up in the middle. Then everyone bets again.
  5. The Turn: A fourth shared card, then another round of betting.
  6. The River: The fifth and last shared card, then the final round of betting.
  7. Showdown: Players still in show their cards. The best five-card hand, using any mix of your two cards and the five shared cards, wins the pot.

Your Buttons

  • Fold: Give up this hand. You lose what you've already put in.
  • Check: Pass without betting, when no one has bet yet.
  • Call: Match the current bet to stay in.
  • Bet / Raise: Put in more. Use Min, ½ Pot or Pot, slide the bar, or type an amount.
  • All-In: Bet every chip you have.

Hand Rankings (best to worst)

Royal FlushA K Q J 10, all the same suit Straight FlushFive cards in a row, all the same suit Four of a KindFour cards of the same rank Full HouseThree of a kind plus a pair FlushAny five cards of the same suit StraightFive cards in a row, mixed suits (A can be high or low) Three of a KindThree cards of the same rank Two PairTwo different pairs One PairTwo cards of the same rank High CardNone of the above. Highest card plays

Helpful Tips

  • The gold line above your buttons always tells you what hand you're holding right now.
  • Watch the Dealer button. Acting last is an advantage.
  • Every player at the table has their own style. Some bluff, some only bet with the goods.
